scientific_integrity: New combinatorial proof, exact labeled counts, and standalone finite checking program. Known scalar connected domination numbers and ordinary prism dominion enumeration are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns all minimum-cardinality connected dominating sets of labeled C_n Cartesian K_2, n>=3; not all inclusion-minimal connected dominating sets. Finite graph checks corroborate but do not prove the general theorem. Publication priority is subject to unindexed literature; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: The exact minimum connected-domination census of circular ladders
